photoSlots.alt: AI-generated fictional Lithuania fashion editorial: four adult women share a back hug, shoulder touch and handclasp in a cream geometric-window studio. Terracotta, yellow-green-red flag-inspired and black-and-ivory mini outfits pair with rainbow boots and platforms. A star arm tattoo is visible. Distant mushroom-shaped smoke is an imaginary effect, not a real event.

AI-generated fictional Lithuania fashion editorial: four adult women lean together around a sea-green couch beside a dune-and-lagoon window. A braided woman in green and a blonde in sand-and-blue sit at left; two dark-haired women in yellow-green-red and navy lean in from the right. Shared hands, rainbow boots and knee-high legwear, and visible arm motifs including GRD and a small heart complete the scene.

AI-generated fictional Jamaica fashion editorial: four adult women share handclasps and shoulder touches around a mint bench under coastal stone arches. Sea-green, coral-ivory, green-black-gold and graphite-turquoise tailoring pairs with varied heels, including rainbow RAZE platforms. A GRD upper-arm mark is visible. Distant smoke and a mushroom-shaped cloud are imaginary effects, not real events.

AI-generated fictional Jamaica fashion scene in a lagoon-window conservatory. Four adult women share a seated shoulder cuddle and gentle hand contact in a tilted composition. Plum-mint, green-black-gold, pearl-turquoise and emerald-ivory outfits appear with rainbow boots, mint sandals and pearl platforms. GRD is visible on the blonde woman upper arm.
